build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with dual levers, balls, and a jar using define_task_template decorator
add_scene_objects: create static and dynamic scene objects like bars, balls, and jars using C.add method
update_task_relationships: define task objectives by setting body relationships like TOUCHING via C.update_task
set_solution_tier: set the task solution tier metadata using C.set_meta with SolutionTier enum values
skip_invalid_params: raise SkipTemplateParams to exclude invalid parameter combinations from task generation
